name: Loopy repository-wide capability recovery

steps.tool: GitHub code search and Code Quarry
steps.gate: Scan repositories by behavior/API; preserve exact owner/path/ref and search coverage, not just one project name
Existing public contract wins; do not fork equivalent functionality
Label reuse/adapt/merge/separate/unresolved; explicit licensing and authority
Implement real independent code, not an inventory pointer; preserve protocol/host boundaries

steps.tool: Node tests + TS consumer + Python pins
steps.gate: Success and adversarial cases; no false live-connection claims
Typed methods, source links, failure behavior, mobile site nav
Verified ZIP readback, inventory update and recovery handoff; no public deployment

no_go: never scrape or republish private keys
do not publish/activate without separate authority
do not reuse rejected Forge as implementation
do not conflate media URL fingerprint with verified blob hash
